items.exampleEn: Retail prices are higher than factory prices.

items.exampleZh: 這家店接受好幾種貨幣。

items.exampleEn: The landlord kept part of our deposit.
items.exampleZh: 房東扣留了我們一部分的押金。

items.exampleEn: Many people play the lottery every week.
items.exampleZh: 很多人每個星期都買彩券。

items.exampleEn: He arrived in the city young and penniless.
items.exampleZh: 他來到這座城市時年紀輕輕、身無分文。

items.sentenceEn: The shop gives a discount if you pay in cash.
items.sentenceZh: 用現金付款的話，這家店會打折。

items.audioEn: To book the room, pay a fifty-dollar deposit. You'll get it back when you leave.
items.audioZh: 要預訂房間，請先付五十美元押金，離開時會退還給你。
options: At the end of the stay

items.sentenceEn: Retail jobs often include weekend work.
items.sentenceZh: 零售業的工作常常要週末上班。

items.sentenceEn: For us, eating at a hotel is a luxury.
items.sentenceZh: 對我們來說，在飯店吃飯是一種奢侈。

items.stemEn: Before you travel, change some money into the local ____.
items.stemZh: 出發旅行前，先把一些錢換成當地貨幣。

items.stemEn: She spent all her money and was ____ by the end of the month.
items.stemZh: 她把錢都花光了，到月底已經身無分文。

items.passageEn: Lena works in retail at a gift shop near the airport. Many tourists pay in foreign currency, and the staff can change it for them. Members get a ten percent discount on most items. Some customers buy expensive watches, which are a luxury for most people. Before New Year, the shop looks very festive. It also sells lottery tickets, but Lena never buys them. Last year, a young traveler lost his wallet there, and Lena helped him call home.
items.passageZh: Lena 在機場附近的一家禮品店從事零售工作。許多觀光客用外幣付款，店員可以幫他們換錢。會員大部分商品可以打九折。有些客人會買昂貴的手錶，對大多數人來說那是奢侈品。新年前，這家店看起來很有節慶氣氛。店裡也賣彩券，但 Lena 從來不買。去年，一位年輕旅客在店裡掉了錢包，Lena 幫他打電話回家。

questions.questionZh: 會員大部分商品可以享有什麼優惠？
去年那位年輕旅客發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 我們付了一百美元的訂金。
referenceEn: We paid a deposit of one hundred dollars.
rubricZh: 「付訂金」可寫，例如 pay a deposit、put down a deposit 等
時態配合內容（例如說已經發生的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 彩券的中獎號碼每週二公布。
referenceEn: The lottery numbers are announced every Tuesday.
They announce the lottery results every Tuesday.
rubricZh: 用 lottery 表示「彩券；樂透」（例如 the lottery numbers、the lottery results 等）
「公布」可寫，例如 are announced、they announce 等
